claimMechanismForensics.claimSql: UPDATE event_outbox SET status=PROCESSING, locked_at=NOW(), locked_by=$instanceId, attempts=attempts+1 WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM event_outbox WHERE status IN (PENDING, FAILED) AND available_at <= NOW() ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT $batchSize FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
claimMechanismForensics.staleLockRecovery: PROCESSING rows with locked_at < now - lockTimeoutMs reset to PENDING

note: Normal short-lived row locks during SKIP LOCKED claim expected; no deadlock or connection exhaustion observed in Step-13 window
